overview: Based on the published agenda, the City of Mosinee Plan Commission was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to consider an application for land use regulation amendments and a conditional use permit for a commercial taxi and non-emergency medical transportation service at 425 Super Street. The meeting was set to include a public hearing and discussion on this proposed business operation.

discussions.item: Commercial Taxi/Non-Emergency Medical Transportation Service - 425 Super Street
discussions.body: The Plan Commission was scheduled to conduct a public hearing and consider an application for land use regulation amendments and a conditional use permit to authorize operation of a commercial taxi and non-emergency medical transportation service at 425 Super Street. Following the public hearing, the commission was expected to discuss and take possible action on this application.
